author: Spread
name: Dotted ring
description: A ring of dots that light up with the value; the number inside (stress, load, readiness).
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.d{fill:none;stroke-width:5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:0 4.2;transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:60px 60px}.off{stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.18}.on{stroke:#4f8bff}.m{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:10;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100);transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:60px 60px}.big{font-size:32px}[data-level="0"] .on{stroke:#4f8bff}[data-level="1"] .on{stroke:#4f8bff}[data-level="2"] .on{stroke:#4f8bff}[data-level="3"] .on{stroke:#4f8bff}[data-level="4"] .on{stroke:#4f8bff}[data-level="5"] .on{stroke:#8b7bff}[data-level="6"] .on{stroke:#b06bff}[data-level="7"] .on{stroke:#e0569a}[data-level="8"] .on{stroke:#ff5a5a}[data-level="9"] .on{stroke:#ff3b30}[data-level="10"] .on{stroke:#ff3b30}</style><defs><mask id="dm"><circle class="m" cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100"/></mask></defs><circle class="d off" cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100"/><circle class="d on" cx="60" cy="60" r="44" pathLength="100" mask="url(#dm)"/>
<text x="60" y="71" text-anchor="middle" class="num big">{{value}}</text></svg>
